mapper.select: SELECT point_wallet_id, user_id, point_balance, DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updated_at FROM point_wallet_tbl WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO point_transaction_tbl ( point_wallet_id, transaction_type, point_amount, reason_type, created_at ) VALUES ( #{pointWalletId}, #{transactionType}, #{pointAmount}, #{reasonType}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
INSERT INTO point_wallet_tbl ( user_id, point_balance ) VALUES ( #{userId}, 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT pt.point_transaction_id AS pointTransactionId, pt.point_wallet_id AS pointWalletId, pt.transaction_type AS transactionType, pt.point_amount AS pointAmount, pt.reason_type AS reasonType, DATE_FORMAT( pt.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) AS createdAt FROM point_transaction_tbl pt INNER JOIN point_wallet_tbl pw ON pw.point_wallet_id = pt.point_wallet_id WHERE pw.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY pt.created_at DESC, pt.point_transaction_id DESC LIMIT 5
